name: stench
effect: Tem 10% de chance de fazer o alvo recuar a cada acerto.
effect_full: This Pokémon's damaging moves have a 10% chance to make the target flinch with each hit if they do not already cause flinching as a secondary effect. This ability does not stack with a held item. Overworld: The wild encounter rate is halved while this Pokémon is first in the party.
flavor: Soltando um fedor ao atacar, o Pokémon pode fazer o alvo recuar.

name: drizzle
effect: Invoca uma chuva que dura sem limite ao entrar na batalha.
effect_full: The weather changes to rain when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless replaced by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drought, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.
flavor: O Pokémon faz chover quando entra na batalha.

name: speed-boost
effect: Aumenta a Velocidade em um estágio depois de cada turno.
effect_full: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage after each turn.
flavor: A Velocidade do Pokémon aumenta a cada turno.

name: battle-armor
effect: Protege contra golpes críticos.
effect_full: Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon. This ability functions identically to Shell Armor.
flavor: Uma armadura dura protege o Pokémon de golpes críticos.

name: sturdy
effect: Impede o nocaute com o PS cheio, deixando 1 de PS. Protege contra golpes de nocaute com um golpe só, qualquer que seja o PS.
effect_full: When this Pokémon is at full HP, any hit that would knock it out will instead leave it with 1 HP. Regardless of its current HP, it is also immune to the one-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold. If this Pokémon is holding a Focus Sash, this ability takes precedence and the item will not be consumed.
flavor: O Pokémon não pode ser nocauteado com um único golpe enquanto o PS estiver cheio. Golpes de nocaute com um golpe só também não o derrubam.

name: damp
effect: Impede que Self-Destruct, Explosion e Aftermath funcionem enquanto o Pokémon estiver na batalha.
effect_full: While this Pokémon is in battle, Self-Destruct and Explosion will fail and Aftermath will not take effect.
flavor: O Pokémon umedece os arredores, impedindo todos os Pokémon de usar golpes explosivos como Self-Destruct.

name: limber
effect: Impede a paralisia.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot be paralyzed. If a Pokémon is paralyzed and acquires this ability, its paralysis is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.
flavor: O corpo flexível do Pokémon impede que ele fique paralisado.

name: sand-veil
effect: Aumenta a Evasão para 1,25× durante tempestade de areia. Protege contra o dano da tempestade de areia.
effect_full: During a sandstorm, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take sandstorm damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.
flavor: Aumenta a Evasão do Pokémon numa tempestade de areia.

name: static
effect: Tem 30% de chance de paralisar Pokémon que o atacarem com contato.
effect_full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed. Pokémon that are immune to Electric-type moves can still be paralyzed by this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, there is a 50% chance that encounters will be with an Electric Pokémon, if applicable.
flavor: O Pokémon está carregado de eletricidade estática e pode paralisar quem fizer contato direto com ele.

name: volt-absorb
effect: Absorve golpes Elétricos, curando 1/4 do PS máximo.
effect_full: Whenever an Electric-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves. Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. Thunder Wave.
flavor: Se for atingido por um golpe do tipo Elétrico, o Pokémon recupera PS em vez de levar dano.

name: water-absorb
effect: Absorve golpes de Água, curando 1/4 do PS máximo.
effect_full: Whenever a Water-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. Water moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute.
flavor: Se for atingido por um golpe do tipo Água, o Pokémon recupera PS em vez de levar dano.

name: oblivious
effect: Impede a paixão e protege contra Captivate.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot be infatuated and is immune to Captivate. If a Pokémon is infatuated and acquires this ability, its infatuation is cleared.
flavor: O Pokémon é distraído, o que o impede de se apaixonar, cair em provocações ou ser afetado por Intimidate.

name: cloud-nine
effect: Anula todos os efeitos do clima, mas não impede o clima em si.
effect_full: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Air Lock.
flavor: Elimina os efeitos do clima.

name: compound-eyes
effect: Aumenta a Precisão dos golpes para 1,3×.
effect_full: This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their accuracy. This ability has no effect on the one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold). Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, the chance of a wild Pokémon holding a particular item is raised from 50%, 5%, or 1% to 60%, 20%, or 5%, respectively.
flavor: Os olhos compostos do Pokémon aumentam a Precisão.

name: insomnia
effect: Impede o sono.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Vital Spirit in battle.
flavor: A insônia do Pokémon o impede de dormir.

name: color-change
effect: Muda de tipo para combinar com o golpe que causar dano a ele.
effect_full: Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move, the Pokémon's type changes to match the move. If the Pokémon has two types, both are overridden. The Pokémon must directly take damage; for example, moves blocked by a Substitute will not trigger this ability, nor will moves that deal damage indirectly, such as Spikes. This ability takes effect on only the last hit of a multiple-hit attack. In Pokémon Colosseum and XD: Gale of Darkness, this ability does not take effect on Shadow-type moves.
flavor: O tipo do Pokémon vira o tipo do golpe usado nele.

name: immunity
effect: Impede o envenenamento.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot be poisoned. This includes bad poison. If a Pokémon is poisoned and acquires this ability, its poison is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.
flavor: O sistema imunológico do Pokémon o impede de ser envenenado.

name: flash-fire
effect: Protege contra golpes de Fogo. Depois de bloquear um, os golpes de Fogo do próprio Pokémon causam 1,5× de dano até ele sair da batalha.
effect_full: This Pokémon is immune to Fire-type moves. Once this Pokémon has been hit by a Fire move, its own Fire moves will inflict 1.5× as much damage until it leaves battle. This ability has no effect while the Pokémon is frozen. The Fire damage bonus is retained even if the Pokémon is frozen and thawed or the ability is lost or disabled. Fire moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This ability takes effect even on non-damaging moves, i.e. Will-O-Wisp.
flavor: Se for atingido por um golpe do tipo Fogo, o Pokémon absorve as chamas e as usa para fortalecer os próprios golpes do tipo Fogo.

name: shield-dust
effect: Protege contra os efeitos extras dos golpes recebidos.
effect_full: This Pokémon is immune to the extra effects of moves used against it. An extra effect is a move's chance, listed as an "effect chance", to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate.
flavor: Um pó protetor protege o Pokémon dos efeitos adicionais dos golpes.

name: own-tempo
effect: Impede a confusão.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot be confused. If a Pokémon is confused and acquires this ability, its confusion will immediately be healed.
flavor: O Pokémon segue o próprio ritmo, o que impede que fique confuso ou seja afetado por Intimidate.

name: suction-cups
effect: Impede que seja forçado a sair da batalha por golpes de outros Pokémon.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot be forced out of battle by moves such as Whirlwind. Dragon Tail and Circle Throw still inflict damage against this Pokémon. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the success rate while fishing is increased.
flavor: O Pokémon usa ventosas para ficar no lugar. Isso o protege de golpes e itens que o forçariam a sair.

name: intimidate
effect: Diminui o Ataque dos oponentes em um estágio ao entrar na batalha.
effect_full: When this Pokémon enters battle, the opponent's Attack is lowered by one stage. In a double battle, both opponents are affected. This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle, but will not take effect again if lost and reobtained without leaving battle. This ability has no effect on an opponent that has a Substitute. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.
flavor: Quando entra na batalha, o Pokémon intimida os adversários e os deixa acuados, diminuindo o Ataque deles.

name: shadow-tag
effect: Impede os oponentes de fugir ou sair da batalha.
effect_full: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Other Pokémon with this ability are unaffected. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item.
flavor: O Pokémon pisa na sombra dos adversários para impedi-los de fugir ou sair da batalha.

name: rough-skin
effect: Causa dano de 1/8 do PS máximo a Pokémon que o atacarem com contato.
effect_full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage. This ability functions identically to Iron Barbs.
flavor: A pele áspera do Pokémon causa dano a quem fizer contato direto com ele.

name: wonder-guard
effect: Protege contra golpes que causam dano e não são supereficazes.
effect_full: This Pokémon is immune to damaging moves that are not super effective against it. Moves that inflict fixed damage, such as Night Shade or Seismic Toss, are considered super effective if their types are. Damage not directly dealt by moves, such as damage from weather, a status ailment, or Spikes, is not prevented. This ability cannot be copied with Role Play or traded away with Skill Swap, but it can be copied with Trace, disabled with Gastro Acid, or changed with Worry Seed. This Pokémon can still use Role Play itself to lose this ability, but not Skill Swap. If this Pokémon has a Substitute, this ability will block moves as usual and any moves not blocked will react to the Substitute as usual.
flavor: Seu poder misterioso só deixa golpes supereficazes atingirem o Pokémon.

name: levitate
effect: Escapa de golpes de Terra.
effect_full: This Pokémon is immune to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Arena Trap. This ability is disabled during Gravity or Ingrain, or while holding an Iron Ball. This ability is not disabled during Roost.
flavor: Flutuando no ar, o Pokémon fica totalmente imune a todos os golpes do tipo Terra.

name: effect-spore
effect: Tem 30% de chance de causar paralisia, envenenamento ou sono em Pokémon que o atacarem com contato.
effect_full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed, poisoned, or put to sleep, chosen at random. Nothing is done to compensate if the move's user is immune to one of these ailments; there is simply a lower chance that the move's user will be affected.
flavor: O contato com o Pokémon pode envenenar, fazer dormir ou paralisar o atacante.

name: synchronize
effect: Copia queimadura, paralisia e envenenamento recebidos para o Pokémon que os causou.
effect_full: Whenever this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, the Pokémon who gave this Pokémon that ailment is also given the ailment. This ability passes back bad poison when this Pokémon is badly poisoned. This ability cannot pass on a status ailment that the Pokémon did not directly receive from another Pokémon, such as the poison from Toxic Spikes or the burn from a Flame Orb. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, wild Pokémon have a 50% chance of having the lead Pokémon's nature, and a 50% chance of being given a random nature as usual, including the lead Pokémon's nature. This does not work on Pokémon received outside of battle or roaming legendaries.
flavor: Se o Pokémon for queimado, paralisado ou envenenado por outro Pokémon, esse Pokémon recebe o mesmo problema de status.

name: clear-body
effect: Impede que os atributos sejam diminuídos por outros Pokémon.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to White Smoke in battle.
flavor: Impede que golpes ou Habilidades de outros Pokémon diminuam os atributos do Pokémon.

name: natural-cure
effect: Cura qualquer problema de status principal ao sair da batalha.
effect_full: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment when it is switched out for another Pokémon. If this ability is acquired during battle, the Pokémon is cured upon leaving battle before losing the temporary ability.
flavor: Os problemas de status do Pokémon são curados quando ele sai da batalha.

name: lightning-rod
effect: Atrai para este Pokémon golpes Elétricos de alvo único, quando possível. Absorve golpes Elétricos, aumentando o Ataque Especial em um estágio.
effect_full: All other Pokémon's single-target Electric-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon if it is an eligible target. Other Pokémon's Electric moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it. If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected. When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon. Follow Me takes precedence over this ability. If the Pokémon is a Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves, its immunity prevents the Special Attack boost.
flavor: O Pokémon atrai todos os golpes do tipo Elétrico. Em vez de levar dano, tem o Ataque Especial aumentado.

name: serene-grace
effect: Dobra a chance de os efeitos extras dos golpes acontecerem.
effect_full: This Pokémon's moves have twice their usual effect chance. An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Flamethrower's chance of burning the target is doubled, but Protect's chance of success and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate are unaffected. Secret Power is unaffected.
flavor: Aumenta a chance de efeitos adicionais acontecerem quando o Pokémon usa seus golpes.

name: swift-swim
effect: Dobra a Velocidade durante a chuva.
effect_full: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during rain. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
flavor: Aumenta a Velocidade do Pokémon na chuva.

name: chlorophyll
effect: Dobra a Velocidade durante sol forte.
effect_full: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during strong sunlight. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
flavor: Aumenta a Velocidade do Pokémon com sol forte.

name: illuminate
effect: Dobra a taxa de encontros com Pokémon selvagens.
effect_full: Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled. This ability has no effect in battle.
flavor: Iluminando os arredores, o Pokémon impede que a Precisão dele diminua.

name: trace
effect: Copia a habilidade de um oponente ao entrar na batalha.
effect_full: When this Pokémon enters battle, it copies a random opponent's ability. This ability cannot copy Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode.
flavor: Quando entra na batalha, o Pokémon copia a Habilidade de um Pokémon adversário.

name: huge-power
effect: Dobra o Ataque na batalha.
effect_full: This Pokémon's Attack is doubled while in battle. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. This ability functions identically to Pure Power.
flavor: Dobra o Ataque do Pokémon.

name: poison-point
effect: Tem 30% de chance de envenenar Pokémon que o atacarem com contato.
effect_full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being poisoned.
flavor: O contato com o Pokémon pode envenenar o atacante.

name: inner-focus
effect: Impede de recuar.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot flinch.
flavor: A concentração intensa do Pokémon impede que ele recue ou seja afetado por Intimidate.

name: magma-armor
effect: Impede o congelamento.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot be frozen. If a Pokémon is frozen and acquires this ability, it will immediately thaw out; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Flame Body.
flavor: A camada de magma quente do Pokémon impede que ele seja congelado.

name: water-veil
effect: Impede queimaduras.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot be burned. If a Pokémon is burned and acquires this ability, its burn is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.
flavor: O véu de água do Pokémon impede que ele seja queimado.

name: magnet-pull
effect: Impede oponentes do tipo Aço de fugir ou sair da batalha.
effect_full: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Steel-type Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, Steel-type Pokémon have a higher encounter rate.
flavor: Impede Pokémon do tipo Aço de fugir, puxando-os com magnetismo.

name: soundproof
effect: Protege contra golpes sonoros.
effect_full: This Pokémon is immune to moves flagged as being sound-based. Heal Bell is unaffected. Uproar still prevents this Pokémon from sleeping. This Pokémon can still receive a Perish Song counter through Baton Pass, and will retain a Perish Song counter if it acquires this ability after Perish Song is used. Howl, Roar of Time, Sonic Boom, and Yawn are not flagged as sound-based.
flavor: O isolamento acústico deixa o Pokémon totalmente imune a todos os golpes sonoros.

name: rain-dish
effect: Cura 1/16 do PS máximo depois de cada turno durante a chuva.
effect_full: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during rain.
flavor: O Pokémon recupera PS aos poucos na chuva.

name: sand-stream
effect: Invoca uma tempestade de areia que dura sem limite ao entrar na batalha.
effect_full: The weather changes to a sandstorm when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.
flavor: O Pokémon invoca uma tempestade de areia quando entra na batalha.

name: pressure
effect: Aumenta em um o custo de PP dos golpes usados contra o Pokémon.
effect_full: Moves targetting this Pokémon use one extra PP. This ability stacks if multiple targets have it. This ability still affects moves that fail or miss. This ability does not affect ally moves that target either the entire field or just its side, nor this Pokémon's self-targetted moves; it does, however, affect single-targetted ally moves aimed at this Pokémon, ally moves that target all other Pokémon, and opponents' moves that target the entire field. If this ability raises a move's PP cost above its remaining PP, it will use all remaining PP. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.
flavor: Pressiona os outros Pokémon, fazendo-os gastar mais PP para usar seus golpes.

name: thick-fat
effect: Reduz pela metade o dano de golpes de Fogo e Gelo.
effect_full: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire- and Ice-type moves.
flavor: O Pokémon é protegido por uma camada grossa de gordura, que reduz pela metade o dano de golpes dos tipos Fogo e Gelo.

name: early-bird
effect: Faz o sono passar duas vezes mais rápido.
effect_full: This Pokémon's remaining sleep turn count falls by 2 rather than 1. If this Pokémon's sleep counter is at 1, it will fall to 0 and then the Pokémon will wake up.
flavor: O Pokémon acorda duas vezes mais rápido que os outros Pokémon.

name: flame-body
effect: Tem 30% de chance de queimar Pokémon que o atacarem com contato.
effect_full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being burned. Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Magma Armor.
flavor: O contato com o Pokémon pode queimar o atacante.

name: run-away
effect: Garante a fuga de batalhas contra Pokémon selvagens.
effect_full: This Pokémon is always successful fleeing from wild battles, even if trapped by a move or ability.
flavor: Permite fugir com certeza de Pokémon selvagens.

name: keen-eye
effect: Impede que a Precisão seja diminuída.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot have its accuracy lowered. This ability does not prevent any accuracy losses other than stat modifiers, such as the accuracy cut from fog; nor does it prevent other Pokémon's evasion from making this Pokémon's moves less accurate. This Pokémon can still be passed negative accuracy modifiers through Heart Swap. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.
flavor: Os olhos aguçados do Pokémon impedem que a Precisão dele diminua.

name: hyper-cutter
effect: Impede que o Ataque seja diminuído por outros Pokémon.
effect_full: This Pokémon's Attack cannot be lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any Attack losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Attack cut from a burn. This Pokémon can still be passed negative Attack modifiers through Heart Swap or Power Swap.
flavor: As pinças poderosas e valiosas do Pokémon impedem que outros Pokémon diminuam o Ataque dele.

name: pickup
effect: Pega itens usados ou arremessados por outros Pokémon. Também pode achar um item depois da batalha.
effect_full: At the end of each turn, if another Pokémon consumed or Flung a held item that turn, this Pokémon picks up the item if it is not already holding one. After each battle, this Pokémon has a 10% chance of picking up an item if it is not already holding one. The Air Balloon and Eject Button cannot be picked up. The items that may be found vary by game, and, since Pokémon Emerald, by the Pokémon's level. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.
flavor: O Pokémon pode pegar um item que outro Pokémon usou na batalha. Também pode achar itens fora da batalha.

name: truant
effect: Perde um turno a cada dois.
effect_full: Every second turn on which this Pokémon should attempt to use a move, it will instead do nothing ("loaf around"). Loafing around interrupts moves that take multiple turns the same way paralysis, flinching, etc do. Most such moves, for example Bide or Rollout, are simply cut off upon loafing around. Attacks with a recharge turn, such as Hyper Beam, do not have to recharge; attacks with a preparation turn, such as Fly, do not end up being used. Moves that are forced over multiple turns and keep going through failure, such as Outrage, Uproar, or any move forced by Encore, keep going as usual. If this Pokémon is confused, its confusion is not checked when loafing around; the Pokémon cannot hurt itself, and its confusion does not end or come closer to ending. If this Pokémon attempts to move but fails, e.g. because of paralysis or Gravity, it still counts as having moved and will loaf around the next turn. If it does not attempt to move, e.g. because it is asleep or frozen, whatever it would have done will be postponed until its next attempt; that is, it will either loaf around or move as usual, depending on what it last did. This ability cannot be changed with Worry Seed, but it can be disabled with Gastro Acid, changed with Role Play, or traded away with Skill Swap.
flavor: Toda vez que o Pokémon usa um golpe, passa o turno seguinte fazendo corpo mole.

name: hustle
effect: Deixa os golpes físicos com 1,5× de dano, mas reduz a Precisão deles para 0,8×.
effect_full: This Pokémon's physical moves do 1.5× as much regular damage, but have 0.8× their usual accuracy. Special moves are unaffected. Moves that do set damage, such as Seismic Toss, have their accuracy affected, but not their damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.
flavor: Aumenta o Ataque do Pokémon, mas diminui a Precisão.

name: cute-charm
effect: Tem 30% de chance de deixar apaixonado quem o atacar com contato.
effect_full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being infatuated. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any wild Pokémon whose species can be either gender has a 2/3 chance of being set to the opposite gender, and a 1/3 chance of having a random gender as usual.
flavor: O Pokémon pode deixar apaixonados os atacantes que fizerem contato direto com ele.

name: plus
effect: Aumenta o Ataque Especial para 1,5× quando um Pokémon aliado tem Plus ou Minus.
effect_full: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. If either ability is disabled by Gastro Acid, both lose their effect.
flavor: Aumenta o Ataque Especial do Pokémon se um aliado com a Habilidade Plus ou Minus também estiver na batalha.

name: minus
effect: Aumenta o Ataque Especial para 1,5× quando um Pokémon aliado tem Plus ou Minus.
effect_full: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. If either ability is disabled by Gastro Acid, both lose their effect.
flavor: Aumenta o Ataque Especial do Pokémon se um aliado com a Habilidade Plus ou Minus também estiver na batalha.

name: forecast
effect: Muda o tipo e a forma de Castform conforme o clima.
effect_full: During rain, strong sunlight, or hail, this Pokémon's type changes to Water, Fire, or Ice, respectively, and its form changes to match. This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than Castform. If the weather ends or becomes anything that does not trigger this ability, or a Pokémon with Air Lock or Cloud Nine enters battle, this Pokémon's type and form revert to their default. If this ability is lost or disabled, this Pokémon cannot change its current type and form until it regains its ability.
flavor: O Pokémon se transforma com o clima, mudando o tipo para Água, Fogo ou Gelo.

name: sticky-hold
effect: Impede que o item segurado seja tirado por outros Pokémon.
effect_full: This Pokémon's hold item cannot be removed by other Pokémon. Damaging moves that would remove this Pokémon's item can still inflict damage against this Pokémon, e.g. Knock Off or Pluck. This Pokémon can still use moves that involve the loss of its own item, e.g. Fling or Trick. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the encounter rate while fishing is increased.
flavor: Os itens do Pokémon grudam no corpo pegajoso e não podem ser tirados por outros Pokémon.

name: shed-skin
effect: Tem 33% de chance de curar qualquer problema de status principal depois de cada turno.
effect_full: After each turn, this Pokémon has a 33% of being cured of any major status ailment.
flavor: O Pokémon pode curar os próprios problemas de status trocando de pele.

name: guts
effect: Aumenta o Ataque para 1,5× quando tem um problema de status principal.
effect_full: Whenever this Pokémon is asleep, burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, it has 1.5× its Attack. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Attack cut from a burn. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
flavor: É tão corajoso que ter um problema de status aumenta o Ataque do Pokémon.

name: marvel-scale
effect: Aumenta a Defesa para 1,5× quando tem um problema de status principal.
effect_full: Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Defense. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
flavor: As escamas maravilhosas do Pokémon aumentam a Defesa se ele tiver um problema de status.

name: liquid-ooze
effect: Causa dano a quem usar golpes de drenar, no valor que curariam.
effect_full: Whenever a Pokémon would heal after hitting this Pokémon with a leeching move like Absorb, it instead loses as many HP as it would usually gain. Dream Eater is unaffected.
flavor: O cheiro forte do líquido que escorre do Pokémon fere atacantes que usam golpes de drenar PS.

name: overgrow
effect: Deixa os golpes de Grama com 1,5× de dano com 1/3 do PS máximo ou menos.
effect_full: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Grass-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
flavor: Fortalece golpes do tipo Grama quando o PS do Pokémon está baixo.

name: blaze
effect: Deixa os golpes de Fogo com 1,5× de dano com 1/3 do PS máximo ou menos.
effect_full: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Fire-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
flavor: Fortalece golpes do tipo Fogo quando o PS do Pokémon está baixo.

name: torrent
effect: Deixa os golpes de Água com 1,5× de dano com 1/3 do PS máximo ou menos.
effect_full: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Water-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
flavor: Fortalece golpes do tipo Água quando o PS do Pokémon está baixo.

name: swarm
effect: Deixa os golpes de Inseto com 1,5× de dano com 1/3 do PS máximo ou menos.
effect_full: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Bug-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is increased.
flavor: Fortalece golpes do tipo Inseto quando o PS do Pokémon está baixo.

name: rock-head
effect: Protege contra dano de recuo.
effect_full: This Pokémon does not receive recoil damage from its recoil moves. Struggle's recoil is unaffected. This ability does not prevent crash damage from missing with Jump Kick or High Jump Kick.
flavor: Protege o Pokémon do dano de recuo.

name: drought
effect: Invoca um sol forte que dura sem limite ao entrar na batalha.
effect_full: The weather changes to strong sunlight when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.
flavor: Deixa o sol forte quando o Pokémon entra na batalha.

name: arena-trap
effect: Impede os oponentes de fugir ou sair da batalha. Não funciona em Pokémon do tipo Voador nem nos que estão no ar.
effect_full: While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Flying-type Pokémon and Pokémon in the air, e.g. due to Levitate or Magnet Rise, are unaffected. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.
flavor: Impede os Pokémon adversários de fugir da batalha.

name: vital-spirit
effect: Impede o sono.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Insomnia in battle. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.
flavor: O Pokémon é cheio de vitalidade, o que o impede de dormir.

name: white-smoke
effect: Impede que os atributos sejam diminuídos por outros Pokémon.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis; nor self-inflicted stat drops, such as the Special Attack drop from Overheat; nor opponent-triggered stat boosts, such as the Attack boost from Swagger. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to Clear Body in battle. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.
flavor: O Pokémon é protegido pela sua fumaça branca, que impede outros Pokémon de diminuir seus atributos.

name: pure-power
effect: Dobra o Ataque na batalha.
effect_full: This Pokémon's Attack is doubled in battle. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. This ability functions identically to Huge Power.
flavor: Usando sua força pura, o Pokémon dobra o Ataque.

name: shell-armor
effect: Protege contra golpes críticos.
effect_full: Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon. This ability functions identically to Battle Armor.
flavor: Uma casca dura protege o Pokémon de golpes críticos.

name: air-lock
effect: Anula todos os efeitos do clima, mas não impede o clima em si.
effect_full: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Cloud Nine.
flavor: Elimina os efeitos do clima.

name: tangled-feet
effect: Dobra a Evasão quando está confuso.
effect_full: When this Pokémon is confused, it has twice its evasion.
flavor: Aumenta a Evasão do Pokémon se ele estiver confuso.

name: motor-drive
effect: Absorve golpes Elétricos, aumentando a Velocidade em um estágio.
effect_full: Whenever an Electric-type move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage, negating any other effect on it. This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is immune to Electric moves. Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. Thunder Wave.
flavor: O Pokémon não leva dano quando é atingido por golpes do tipo Elétrico. Em vez disso, a Velocidade aumenta.

name: rivalry
effect: Aumenta o dano para 1,25× contra Pokémon do mesmo gênero, mas diminui para 0,75× contra o gênero oposto.
effect_full: This Pokémon inflicts 1.25× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the same gender and 0.75× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the opposite gender. If either Pokémon is genderless, damage is unaffected.
flavor: O espírito competitivo do Pokémon faz ele causar mais dano a Pokémon do mesmo gênero, mas menos dano aos do gênero oposto.

name: steadfast
effect: Aumenta a Velocidade em um estágio ao recuar.
effect_full: Whenever this Pokémon flinches, its Speed rises one stage.
flavor: A determinação do Pokémon aumenta a Velocidade toda vez que ele recua.

name: snow-cloak
effect: Aumenta a Evasão para 1,25× durante granizo. Protege contra o dano do granizo.
effect_full: During hail, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in snow.
flavor: Aumenta a Evasão do Pokémon na neve.

name: gluttony
effect: Faz o Pokémon comer uma fruta de PS baixo quando o PS cai abaixo de 1/2 do máximo.
effect_full: This Pokémon eats any held Berry triggered by low HP when it falls below 50% of its HP, regardless of the Berry's usual threshold.
flavor: Se o Pokémon estiver segurando uma fruta para comer quando o PS está baixo, ele a come quando o PS cai para a metade ou menos.

name: anger-point
effect: Aumenta o Ataque ao máximo de seis estágios ao receber um golpe crítico.
effect_full: Whenever this Pokémon receives a critical hit, its Attack rises to the maximum of 6 stages. This ability will still take effect if the critical hit is received by a Substitute.
flavor: O Pokémon fica furioso quando leva um golpe crítico, e isso maximiza o Ataque.

name: unburden
effect: Dobra a Velocidade ao usar ou perder o item segurado.
effect_full: When this Pokémon uses or loses its held item, its Speed is doubled. If it gains another item or leaves battle, this bonus is lost. This includes when the Pokémon drops its item because of Knock Off. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. There is no notification when this ability takes effect.
flavor: Aumenta a Velocidade se o item do Pokémon for usado ou perdido.

name: heatproof
effect: Reduz pela metade o dano de golpes de Fogo e de queimaduras.
effect_full: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire-type moves and burns.
flavor: O corpo resistente ao calor do Pokémon reduz pela metade o dano de golpes do tipo Fogo.

name: simple
effect: Dobra os modificadores de atributos do Pokémon. Mesmo dobrados, continuam limitados a -6 ou 6 estágios.
effect_full: Each stage of this Pokémon's stat modifiers acts as two stages. These doubled stages are still limited to a minimum of -6 and a maximum of 6. This Pokémon can still accumulate less than -3 or more than 3 stages of stat modifiers, even though the extra ones have no effect after doubling.
flavor: Dobra os efeitos das mudanças de atributos do Pokémon.

name: dry-skin
effect: Causa dano de 1/8 do PS máximo a cada turno com sol forte, mas cura 1/8 do PS máximo durante a chuva. Aumenta o dano de golpes de Fogo para 1,25×, mas absorve golpes de Água, curando 1/4 do PS máximo.
effect_full: This Pokémon takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn during strong sunlight, but it heals for 1/8 of its HP each turn during rain. This Pokémon takes 1.25× as much damage from Fire-type moves, but whenever a Water move hits it, it heals for 1/4 its maximum HP instead.
flavor: Recupera o PS do Pokémon na chuva ou quando é atingido por golpes do tipo Água. Diminui o PS com sol forte e aumenta o dano recebido de golpes do tipo Fogo.

name: download
effect: Ao entrar na batalha, aumenta em um estágio o atributo de ataque que corresponde à defesa mais fraca dos oponentes.
effect_full: When this Pokémon enters battle, its Attack or Special Attack, whichever corresponds to its opponents' weaker total defensive stat, rises one stage. In the event of a tie, Special Attack is raised. This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle.
flavor: O Pokémon compara a Defesa e a Defesa Especial de um adversário antes de aumentar o próprio Ataque ou Ataque Especial, o que for mais eficaz.

name: iron-fist
effect: Deixa os golpes de soco com 1,2× de poder.
effect_full: Moves flagged as being punch-based have 1.2× their base power for this Pokémon. Sucker Punch is not flagged as punch-based; its original, Japanese name only means "surprise attack".
flavor: Fortalece golpes de soco.

name: poison-heal
effect: Quando envenenado, cura 1/8 do PS máximo depois de cada turno em vez de levar dano.
effect_full: If this Pokémon is poisoned, it will heal for 1/8 of its maximum HP after each turn rather than taking damage. This includes bad poison.
flavor: Se estiver envenenado, o Pokémon recupera PS em vez de levar dano.

name: adaptability
effect: Aumenta o bônus de ataque do mesmo tipo de 1,5× para 2×.
effect_full: This Pokémon inflicts twice as much damage with moves whose types match its own, rather than the usual same-type attack bonus of 1.5×.
flavor: Fortalece golpes do mesmo tipo do Pokémon.

name: skill-link
effect: Faz golpes de dois a cinco acertos e Triple Kick acertarem sempre o número máximo de vezes.
effect_full: This Pokémon always hits five times with two-to-five-hit moves, such as Icicle Spear. It also bypasses the accuracy checks on Triple Kick's second and third hits.
flavor: Maximiza o número de acertos de golpes que acertam várias vezes.

name: hydration
effect: Cura qualquer problema de status principal depois de cada turno durante a chuva.
effect_full: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment after each turn during rain.
flavor: Cura os problemas de status do Pokémon na chuva.

name: solar-power
effect: Aumenta o Ataque Especial para 1,5×, mas custa 1/8 do PS máximo depois de cada turno com sol forte.
effect_full: During strong sunlight, this Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack but takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn.
flavor: Com sol forte, o Ataque Especial do Pokémon aumenta, mas o PS diminui a cada turno.

name: quick-feet
effect: Aumenta a Velocidade para 1,5× quando tem um problema de status principal.
effect_full: Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Speed. This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Speed cut from paralysis. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.
flavor: Aumenta a Velocidade se o Pokémon tiver um problema de status.

name: normalize
effect: Faz todos os golpes do Pokémon agirem como tipo Normal.
effect_full: This Pokémon's moves all act as if they were Normal-type. Moves that inflict typeless damage do so as usual. Moves of variable type, such as Hidden Power, are affected. They otherwise work as usual, however; Weather Ball, for example, is always forced to be Normal, but it still has doubled power and looks different during weather. As Thunder Wave is prevented by immunities, unlike most non-damaging moves, it does not affect Ghost-type Pokémon under the effect of this ability.
flavor: Todos os golpes do Pokémon viram do tipo Normal. O poder desses golpes aumenta um pouco.

name: sniper
effect: Deixa os golpes críticos com 3× de dano em vez de 2×.
effect_full: This Pokémon inflicts triple damage with critical hits, rather than the usual double damage.
flavor: Se o ataque do Pokémon for um acerto crítico, o ataque fica ainda mais forte.

name: magic-guard
effect: Protege contra dano que não seja causado diretamente por um golpe.
effect_full: This Pokémon is immune to damage not directly caused by a move. For example, this Pokémon takes no damage from from weather, recoil, status ailments, or Spikes, but it still suffers from the Attack cut when burned, and a Life Orb will still power up this Pokémon's moves without damaging it. Anything that directly depends on such damage will also not happen; for example, Leech Seed will neither hurt this Pokémon nor heal the opponent, and Pokémon with a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry will not consume the berry when hit by this Pokémon. The following are unaffected: Struggle, Pain Split (whether used by or against this Pokémon), Belly Drum, Substitute, Curse, moves that knock the user out, and damage from confusion. This Pokémon will neither lose nor regain HP if it drains HP from a Pokémon with Liquid Ooze. If this Pokémon is badly poisoned, the poison counter is still increased each turn; if the Pokémon loses this ability, it will begin taking as much damage as it would be if it had been taking increasing damage each turn.
flavor: O Pokémon só leva dano de ataques.

name: no-guard
effect: Garante que todos os golpes usados pelo Pokémon e contra ele acertem.
effect_full: Moves used by or against this Pokémon never miss. One-hit KO moves are unaffected. Moves affected by this ability can hit Pokémon during the preparation turn of moves like Dig or Fly. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.
flavor: O Pokémon usa a tática de guarda aberta para garantir que os ataques recebidos e dados sempre acertem.

name: stall
effect: Faz o Pokémon agir por último dentro da faixa de prioridade do golpe.
effect_full: This Pokémon moves last within its priority bracket. Multiple Pokémon with this ability move in order of Speed amongst themselves. The Full Incense and Lagging Tail take precedence over this ability; that is, Pokémon with these items move after Pokémon with this ability. Pokémon with both this ability and one of these items are delayed as much as if they had only the item. This ability works as usual during Trick Room: Pokémon with this ability will move in reverse order of Speed after Pokémon without it.
flavor: O Pokémon é sempre o último a usar seus golpes.

name: technician
effect: Deixa golpes com poder base de 60 ou menos com 1,5× de poder.
effect_full: This Pokémon's moves have 1.5× their power if their base power is 60 or less. This includes moves of variable power, such as Hidden Power and Magnitude, when their power is 60 or less. Helping Hand's power boost is taken into account for any move, as is Defense Curl's power boost for Rollout.
flavor: Fortalece golpes fracos para que o Pokémon cause mais dano com eles.

name: leaf-guard
effect: Protege contra problemas de status principais com sol forte.
effect_full: This Pokémon cannot be given a major status ailment during strong sunlight. This ability does not heal prior status ailments. Rest will fail altogether with this ability in effect. Yawn will immediately fail if used on this Pokémon during strong sunlight, and an already-used Yawn will fail if the weather turns to strong sunlight in the meantime.
flavor: Impede problemas de status com sol forte.

name: klutz
effect: Impede o Pokémon de usar o item que segura na batalha.
effect_full: In battle, this Pokémon cannot use its held item, nor will the item have any passive effect on the battle, positive or negative. This Pokémon also cannot use Fling. The Speed cut from the Iron Ball and the effort items (the Macho Brace, Power Weight, Power Bracer, Power Belt, Power Lens, Power Band, and Power Anklet) is unaffected. Items that do not directly affect the battle, such as the Exp. Share, the Amulet Coin, or the Soothe Bell, work as usual. All held items work as usual out of battle. Other moves that use the held item, such as Natural Gift and Switcheroo, work as usual.
flavor: O Pokémon não consegue usar nenhum item que segura.

name: mold-breaker
effect: Ignora as habilidades dos alvos que poderiam atrapalhar ou impedir um golpe.
effect_full: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target. For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle. This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to Teravolt and Turboblaze.
flavor: Os golpes do Pokémon não são atrapalhados pela Habilidade do alvo.

name: super-luck
effect: Aumenta em um estágio a chance de golpe crítico dos golpes.
effect_full: This Pokémon's moves have critical hit rates one stage higher than normal.
flavor: O Pokémon tem tanta sorte que a chance de acerto crítico dos golpes aumenta.

name: aftermath
effect: Causa dano de 1/4 do PS máximo ao atacante quando é nocauteado por um golpe de contato.
effect_full: When this Pokémon is knocked out by a move that makes contact, the move's user takes 1/4 its maximum HP in damage.
flavor: Causa dano ao atacante se ele nocautear o Pokémon com um golpe de contato direto.

name: anticipation
effect: Ao entrar na batalha, avisa todos os treinadores se um oponente tem um golpe supereficaz, Self-Destruct, Explosion ou um golpe de nocaute com um golpe só.
effect_full: When this Pokémon enters battle, if one of its opponents has a move that is super effective against it, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit knockout move, all participating trainers are notified. The move itself is not revealed; only that there is such a move. Moves that inflict typeless damage, such as Future Sight, and moves of variable type, such as Hidden Power, count as their listed types. Counter, Metal Burst, Mirror Coat, and one-hit KO moves to which this Pokémon is immune do not trigger this ability.
flavor: O Pokémon consegue sentir os golpes perigosos de um adversário.

name: forewarn
effect: Revela o golpe mais forte dos oponentes ao entrar na batalha.
effect_full: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals the move with the highest base power known by any opposing Pokémon to all participating trainers. In the event of a tie, one is chosen at random. Moves without a listed base power are assigned one as follows: Power | Moves ----: | ----- 160 | One-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold 120 | Counter moves: Counter, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat 80 | Variable power or set damage: Crush Grip, Dragon Rage, Electro Ball, Endeavor, Final Gambit, Flail, Frustration, Grass Knot, Gyro Ball, Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Hidden Power, Low Kick, Natural Gift, Night Shade, Psywave, Return, Reversal, Seismic Toss, Sonic Boom, Trump Card, and Wring Out 0 | Any such move not listed
flavor: Quando entra na batalha, o Pokémon descobre um dos golpes de um adversário.

name: unaware
effect: Ignora os modificadores de atributos de outros Pokémon no cálculo de dano e de Precisão.
effect_full: This Pokémon ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for the purposes of damage and accuracy calculation. Effectively, this affects modifiers of every stat except Speed. The power of Punishment and Stored Power is calculated as usual. When this Pokémon hurts itself in confusion, its stat modifiers affect damage as usual.
flavor: Ao atacar, o Pokémon ignora as mudanças de atributos do alvo.

name: tinted-lens
effect: Dobra o dano causado por golpes pouco eficazes.
effect_full: This Pokémon deals twice as much damage with moves that are not very effective against the target.
flavor: O Pokémon consegue usar golpes “pouco eficazes” para causar dano normal.

name: filter
effect: Diminui em 1/4 o dano recebido de golpes supereficazes.
effect_full: This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it. This ability functions identically to Solid Rock.
flavor: Reduz o poder de ataques supereficazes que atingem o Pokémon.

name: slow-start
effect: Reduz o Ataque e a Velocidade pela metade por cinco turnos ao entrar na batalha.
effect_full: This Pokémon's Attack and Speed are halved for five turns upon entering battle. This ability also takes effect when acquired during battle. If this Pokémon loses its ability before the five turns are up, its Attack and Speed return to normal; if it then regains this ability without leaving battle, its Attack and Speed are halved again, but the counter keeps counting from where it was.
flavor: Por cinco turnos, o Ataque e a Velocidade do Pokémon ficam pela metade.

name: scrappy
effect: Permite que os golpes Normal e Lutador do Pokémon acertem Pokémon Fantasma.
effect_full: This Pokémon ignores Ghost-type Pokémon's immunity to Normal- and Fighting-type moves. Ghost Pokémon's other types affect damage as usual.
flavor: O Pokémon consegue acertar Pokémon do tipo Fantasma com golpes dos tipos Normal e Lutador. Também não é afetado por Intimidate.

name: storm-drain
effect: Atrai para este Pokémon golpes de Água de alvo único, quando possível. Absorve golpes de Água, aumentando o Ataque Especial em um estágio.
effect_full: All other Pokémon's single-target Water-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon, if it is an eligible target. Other Pokémon's Water moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it. If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected. When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon. Follow Me takes precedence over this ability.
flavor: O Pokémon atrai todos os golpes do tipo Água. Em vez de levar dano, tem o Ataque Especial aumentado.

name: ice-body
effect: Cura 1/16 do PS máximo depois de cada turno durante granizo. Protege contra o dano do granizo.
effect_full: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during hail, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type.
flavor: O Pokémon recupera PS aos poucos na neve.

name: solid-rock
effect: Diminui em 1/4 o dano recebido de golpes supereficazes.
effect_full: This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it. This ability functions identically to Filter.
flavor: Reduz o poder de ataques supereficazes que atingem o Pokémon.

name: snow-warning
effect: Invoca granizo que dura sem limite ao entrar na batalha.
effect_full: The weather changes to hail when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Sand Stream are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.
flavor: O Pokémon faz nevar quando entra na batalha.

name: honey-gather
effect: O Pokémon pode achar Honey depois da batalha.
effect_full: This Pokémon has a chance of picking up Honey after each battle. This chance starts at 5% and rises another 5% after every tenth level: 5% from level 1–10, 10% from 11–20, and so on, up to 50% from 91–100. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.
flavor: O Pokémon pode coletar Honey depois de uma batalha.

name: frisk
effect: Revela o item de um oponente ao entrar na batalha.
effect_full: When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals an opposing Pokémon's held item to all participating trainers. In a double battle, if one opponent has an item, this Pokémon will Frisk that Pokémon; if both have an item, it will Frisk one at random.
flavor: Quando entra na batalha, o Pokémon consegue ver o item que um adversário segura.

name: reckless
effect: Deixa os golpes com recuo com 1,2× de poder.
effect_full: This Pokémon's recoil moves and crash moves have 1.2× their base power. Struggle is unaffected. The "crash moves" are the moves that damage the user upon missing: Jump Kick and High Jump Kick.
flavor: Fortalece golpes que causam dano de recuo.

name: multitype
effect: Muda o tipo e a forma de Arceus conforme a placa que segura.
effect_full: If this Pokémon is holding an elemental Plate, its type and form change to match the Plate. This Pokémon's held item, whether or not it is a Plate, cannot be taken by Covet or Thief, nor removed by Knock Off, nor traded by Switcheroo or Trick. Covet, Thief, and Knock Off still inflict damage against this Pokémon. Unlike with Sticky Hold, this Pokémon cannot use Fling, Switcheroo, or Trick to lose its item itself, nor gain an item through Switcheroo or Trick if it does not have one. This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than Arceus. This ability cannot be traded with Skill Swap, nor copied with Role Play or Trace, nor disabled with Gastro Acid, nor changed with Worry Seed. This Pokémon cannot use Skill Swap or Role Play to lose its ability itself. Mold Breaker cannot ignore this ability. If a Pokémon Transforms into an Arceus with this ability, it will Transform into Arceus's default, Normal-type form. If the Transforming Pokémon is holding a Plate, this ability will then activate and change the Pokémon into the corresponding form.
flavor: Muda o tipo do Pokémon conforme a placa que ele segura.

name: flower-gift
effect: Aumenta o Ataque e a Defesa Especial dos Pokémon aliados para 1,5× com sol forte.
effect_full: Friendly Pokémon have 1.5× their Attack and Special Defense during strong sunlight if any friendly Pokémon has this ability. Unlike Forecast, Multitype, and Zen Mode, this ability is not tied to its Pokémon's form change; Cherrim will switch between its forms even if it loses this ability. As such, this ability also works if obtained by a Pokémon other than Cherrim.
flavor: Aumenta o Ataque e a Defesa Especial do Pokémon e dos aliados com sol forte.

name: bad-dreams
effect: Causa dano de 1/8 do PS máximo aos oponentes dormindo depois de cada turno.
effect_full: Opposing Pokémon take 1/8 of their maximum HP in damage after each turn while they are asleep.
flavor: Causa dano aos Pokémon adversários que estão dormindo.

name: pickpocket
effect: Rouba o item de Pokémon que o atacarem com contato.
effect_full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, if it does not have a held item, it steals the attacker's held item. This Pokémon cannot steal upon being knocked out. It can steal if the attacker has a Substitute, but cannot steal when its own Substitute is hit. If a move hits multiple times, only the last hit triggers this ability. If this Pokémon is wild, it cannot steal from a trained Pokémon.
flavor: O Pokémon rouba o item de atacantes que fizerem contato direto com ele.

name: sheer-force
effect: Deixa golpes com efeitos extras com 1,3× de poder, mas impede os efeitos extras.
effect_full: This Pokémon's moves with extra effects have 1.3× their power, but lose their extra effects. An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate. Moves that lower the user's stats are unaffected.
flavor: Remove os efeitos adicionais dos golpes do Pokémon, mas aumenta o poder deles.

name: contrary
effect: Inverte as mudanças de atributos.
effect_full: Whenever this Pokémon's stats would be raised, they are instead lowered by the same amount, and vice versa.
flavor: Inverte as mudanças de atributos do Pokémon: tentativas de aumentar os atributos os diminuem, e tentativas de diminuir os aumentam.

name: unnerve
effect: Impede os Pokémon adversários de comer as frutas que seguram.
effect_full: Opposing Pokémon cannot eat held Berries while this Pokémon is in battle. Affected Pokémon can still use Bug Bite or Pluck to eat a target's Berry.
flavor: Deixa os Pokémon adversários nervosos e incapazes de comer frutas.

name: defiant
effect: Aumenta o Ataque em dois estágios quando algum atributo é diminuído.
effect_full: When any of this Pokémon's stats are lowered, its Attack rises by two stages. If multiple stats are lowered at once, this ability takes effect with each stat lowered.
flavor: Se algum atributo do Pokémon for diminuído por um adversário, o Ataque aumenta muito.

name: defeatist
effect: Reduz o Ataque e o Ataque Especial pela metade com 50% do PS máximo ou menos.
effect_full: This Pokémon's Attack and Special Attack are halved when it has half its HP or less.
flavor: Reduz pela metade o Ataque e o Ataque Especial do Pokémon quando o PS chega à metade ou menos.

name: cursed-body
effect: Tem 30% de chance de desativar qualquer golpe que atingir o Pokémon.
effect_full: Moves that hit this Pokémon have a 30% chance of being Disabled afterward.
flavor: Pode desativar um golpe que causou dano ao Pokémon.

name: healer
effect: Tem 30% de chance de curar cada aliado ao lado de qualquer problema de status principal depois de cada turno.
effect_full: Friendly Pokémon next to this Pokémon in double and triple battles each have a 30% chance of being cured of any major status ailment after each turn.
flavor: Às vezes cura os problemas de status dos aliados do Pokémon.

name: friend-guard
effect: Diminui para 0,75× todo o dano direto recebido pelos Pokémon aliados.
effect_full: All friendly Pokémon take 0.75× as much direct damage from moves while this Pokémon is in battle. This effect stacks if multiple allied Pokémon have it.
flavor: Reduz o dano causado aos aliados.

name: weak-armor
effect: Aumenta a Velocidade e diminui a Defesa em um estágio cada quando é atingido por um golpe físico.
effect_full: Whenever a physical move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage and its Defense falls one stage. This ability triggers on every hit of a multiple-hit move.
flavor: A Defesa do Pokémon diminui quando ele leva dano de golpes físicos, mas a Velocidade aumenta muito.

name: heavy-metal
effect: Dobra o peso do Pokémon.
effect_full: This Pokémon has double the usual weight for its species.
flavor: Dobra o peso do Pokémon.

name: light-metal
effect: Reduz o peso do Pokémon pela metade.
effect_full: This Pokémon has half the usual weight for its species.
flavor: Reduz o peso do Pokémon pela metade.

name: multiscale
effect: Reduz pela metade o dano recebido com o PS cheio.
effect_full: This Pokémon takes half as much damage when it is hit having full HP.
flavor: Reduz o dano que o Pokémon recebe enquanto o PS está cheio.

name: toxic-boost
effect: Aumenta o Ataque para 1,5× quando está envenenado.
effect_full: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Attack when poisoned.
flavor: Fortalece golpes físicos quando o Pokémon está envenenado.

name: flare-boost
effect: Aumenta o Ataque Especial para 1,5× quando está queimado.
effect_full: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack when burned.
flavor: Fortalece golpes especiais quando o Pokémon está queimado.

name: harvest
effect: Tem 50% de chance de recuperar uma fruta usada depois de cada turno, se o Pokémon não tiver segurado outro item nesse meio-tempo.
effect_full: After each turn, if the last item this Pokémon consumed was a Berry and it is not currently holding an item, it has a 50% chance of regaining that Berry, or a 100% chance during strong sunlight.
flavor: Pode criar outra fruta depois de usar uma.

name: telepathy
effect: Protege contra golpes de dano dos Pokémon aliados.
effect_full: This Pokémon does not take damage from friendly Pokémon's moves, including single-target moves aimed at it.
flavor: O Pokémon prevê e desvia dos ataques dos aliados.

name: moody
effect: Aumenta um atributo aleatório em dois estágios e diminui outro em um estágio depois de cada turno.
effect_full: After each turn, one of this Pokémon's stats at random rises two stages, and another falls one stage. If a stat is already at 6 or -6 stages, it will not be chosen to be increased or decreased, respectively.
flavor: A cada turno, um dos atributos do Pokémon aumenta muito, mas outro diminui.

name: overcoat
effect: Protege contra dano do clima.
effect_full: This Pokémon does not take damage from weather.
flavor: O Pokémon não leva dano de tempestades de areia. Também é protegido dos efeitos de pós e esporos.

name: poison-touch
effect: Tem 30% de chance de envenenar o alvo ao fazer contato.
effect_full: This Pokémon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning the target with each hit. This counts as an extra effect for the purposes of Shield Dust. This ability takes effect before Mummy.

effect: Cura 1/3 do PS máximo ao sair da batalha.
effect_full: This Pokémon regains 1/3 of its maximum HP when it is switched out for another Pokémon under any circumstances other than having fainted. This ability does not take effect when a battle ends.
flavor: O Pokémon recupera um pouco de PS quando sai da batalha.

name: big-pecks
effect: Protege contra quedas de Defesa.
effect_full: This Pokémon's Defense cannot be lowered by other Pokémon. This Pokémon can still be passed negative Defense modifiers through Heart Swap or Guard Swap.
flavor: Impede que a Defesa do Pokémon seja diminuída.

name: sand-rush
effect: Dobra a Velocidade durante tempestade de areia. Protege contra o dano da tempestade de areia.
effect_full: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during a sandstorm, and it does not take sandstorm damage, regardless of type.
flavor: Aumenta a Velocidade do Pokémon numa tempestade de areia.

name: wonder-skin
effect: Reduz a Precisão base dos golpes que não causam dano recebidos para exatamente 50%.
effect_full: Non-damaging moves have exactly 50% base accuracy against this Pokémon.
flavor: Faz os golpes de status terem mais chance de errar o Pokémon.

name: analytic
effect: Deixa os golpes com 1,3× de poder quando age por último.
effect_full: This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their power when it moves last in a turn. Future Sight and Doom Desire are unaffected.
flavor: Aumenta o poder do golpe do Pokémon se ele for o último a agir no turno.

name: illusion
effect: Ao entrar, assume a aparência do último Pokémon consciente da equipe até ser atingido por um golpe que causa dano.

name: imposter

flavor: O contato com o Pokémon muda a Habilidade do atacante para Mummy.

name: moxie
effect: Aumenta o Ataque em um estágio ao nocautear um Pokémon.
effect_full: This Pokémon's Attack rises one stage upon knocking out another Pokémon, even a friendly Pokémon. This ability does not take effect when the Pokémon indirectly causes another Pokémon to faint, e.g. through poison or Spikes. If this Pokémon knocks out a Pokémon with Mummy, the former's ability will change without taking effect.
flavor: Quando o Pokémon nocauteia um alvo, mostra atitude, o que aumenta o Ataque.

name: justified

flavor: Quando o Pokémon é atingido por um ataque do tipo Sombrio, o senso de justiça aumenta o Ataque dele.

flavor: O Pokémon se assusta quando é atingido por um ataque dos tipos Sombrio, Fantasma ou Inseto, ou quando é intimidado, o que aumenta a Velocidade.

name: magic-bounce
effect: Reflete a maioria dos golpes que não causam dano de volta para quem os usou.
effect_full: When this Pokémon is targeted by a move flagged as being reflectable, the move is redirected to its user. All reflectable moves are non-damaging, and most non-damaging moves that target other Pokémon are reflectable. A move reflected by this ability or Magic Coat cannot be reflected back.
flavor: O Pokémon reflete golpes de status em vez de ser atingido por eles.

flavor: Dá prioridade aos golpes de status do Pokémon.

effect_full: During a sandstorm, this Pokémon's Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves have 1.3× their base power. This Pokémon does not take sandstorm damage, regardless of type.
flavor: Aumenta o poder dos golpes dos tipos Pedra, Terra e Aço numa tempestade de areia.

name: iron-barbs
effect: Causa dano de 1/8 do PS máximo a Pokémon que o atacarem com contato.
effect_full: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage. This ability functions identically to Rough Skin.
flavor: Causa dano ao atacante com farpas de ferro quando há contato.

name: zen-mode

Below 50% of its maximum HP, it switches to Zen Mode, and at 50% or above, it switches to Standard Mode. This Pokémon returns to Standard Mode upon leaving battle or losing this ability. This ability has no effect if this Pokémon is not a Darmanitan.
flavor: Muda a forma do Pokémon quando o PS está na metade ou menos.

name: victory-star
effect: Aumenta a Precisão dos golpes dos Pokémon aliados para 1,1×.
effect_full: All friendly Pokémon's moves, including this Pokémon's own moves, have 1.1× their usual accuracy while this Pokémon is in battle.
flavor: Aumenta a Precisão do Pokémon e dos aliados.

name: turboblaze
effect: Ignora as habilidades dos alvos que poderiam atrapalhar ou impedir golpes.
effect_full: This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target. For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat. If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way. Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected. For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user. This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle. This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all. An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used. For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed. When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. This ability functions identically to Mold Breaker and Teravolt.
flavor: Os golpes do Pokémon não são atrapalhados pela Habilidade do alvo.

flavor: Os golpes do Pokémon não são atrapalhados pela Habilidade do alvo.

name: aroma-veil
effect: Protege os aliados de golpes que afetam o estado mental.
effect_full: Protects allies against moves that affect their mental state.
flavor: Protege o Pokémon e os aliados de efeitos que impedem o uso de golpes.

name: flower-veil
effect: Protege os Pokémon aliados do tipo Grama de terem os atributos diminuídos por outros Pokémon.
effect_full: Protects friendly Grass Pokémon from having their stats lowered by other Pokémon.
flavor: Os Pokémon aliados do tipo Grama ficam protegidos de problemas de status e de terem os atributos diminuídos.

name: cheek-pouch
effect: Recupera PS ao comer uma fruta, além do efeito da fruta.
effect_full: Restores HP upon eating a Berry, in addition to the Berry's effect.
flavor: O PS do Pokémon é recuperado quando ele come qualquer fruta, além do efeito normal da fruta.

effect: Muda o tipo do Pokémon para combinar com cada golpe que usa.
effect_full: Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses. The type change takes place just before the move is used.
flavor: Muda o tipo do Pokémon para o tipo do golpe que ele vai usar. Só funciona uma vez cada vez que o Pokémon entra na batalha.

name: fur-coat
effect: Reduz pela metade o dano de ataques físicos.
effect_full: Halves damage from physical attacks.
flavor: Reduz pela metade o dano de golpes físicos.

name: magician
effect: Rouba o item do alvo quando o Pokémon usa um golpe que causa dano.
effect_full: Steals the target's held item when the bearer uses a damaging move.
flavor: O Pokémon rouba o item de qualquer alvo que acertar com um golpe.

name: bulletproof
effect: Protege contra golpes de projétil, bola e bomba.
effect_full: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.

effect: Aumenta o Ataque Especial em dois estágios quando algum atributo é diminuído.
effect_full: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.

effect: Deixa os golpes de mordida com 1,5× de poder.
effect_full: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.
flavor: A mandíbula forte do Pokémon aumenta o poder dos golpes de mordida.

effect: Transforma os golpes Normal do Pokémon em golpes de Gelo e os deixa com 1,3× de poder.
effect_full: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Ice-type moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

name: sweet-veil
effect: Impede os Pokémon aliados de dormir.
effect_full: Prevents friendly Pokémon from sleeping.
flavor: Impede o Pokémon e os aliados de dormir.

name: stance-change
effect: Muda Aegislash para a Forma Lâmina antes de usar um golpe que causa dano, ou para a Forma Escudo antes de usar King's Shield.
effect_full: Changes Aegislash to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using King’s Shield.

effect: Aumenta em um estágio a prioridade dos golpes Voadores.
effect_full: Raises Flying moves' priority by one stage.

name: mega-launcher
effect: Deixa os golpes de aura e pulso com 1,5× de poder.
effect_full: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.
flavor: Fortalece golpes de pulso.

name: grass-pelt
effect: Aumenta a Defesa enquanto Grassy Terrain estiver ativo.
effect_full: Boosts Defense while Grassy Terrain is in effect.
flavor: Aumenta a Defesa do Pokémon no Grassy Terrain.

name: symbiosis
effect: Passa o item do Pokémon para um aliado quando o aliado gasta o próprio item.
effect_full: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.
flavor: O Pokémon passa o item que segura para um aliado que gastou um item.

name: tough-claws
effect: Deixa os golpes de contato com 1,33× de poder.
effect_full: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.

effect: Transforma os golpes Normal do Pokémon em golpes de Fada e os deixa com 1,3× de poder.
effect_full: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Fairy moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

name: gooey
effect: Diminui a Velocidade de quem o atacar com contato em um estágio.
effect_full: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.

effect: Transforma os golpes Normal do Pokémon em golpes Voadores e os deixa com 1,3× de poder.

effect: Faz o Pokémon acertar duas vezes com golpes que causam dano. O segundo acerto tem metade do poder.

effect_full: While this Pokémon is on the field, Dark Aura and Fairy Aura weaken moves of their respective types to 2/3 their power, rather than strengthening them.
flavor: Os efeitos das Habilidades de “Aura” são invertidos e diminuem o poder dos golpes afetados.

effect: Cria uma chuva pesada, que tem todas as propriedades de Rain Dance, não pode ser substituída e faz golpes de Fogo que causam dano falharem.

Air Lock and Cloud Nine will prevent the effects of heavy rain, including allowing Fire moves to work, but will not allow the weather to be changed.
flavor: O Pokémon muda o clima para anular ataques do tipo Fogo.

name: desolate-land
effect: Cria um sol extremamente forte, que tem todas as propriedades de Sunny Day, não pode ser substituído e faz golpes de Água que causam dano falharem.

Extremely harsh sunlight has all the properties of Sunny Day and also causes damaging Water moves to fail. Extremely harsh sunlight ends when this Pokémon leaves battle or loses this ability, or when this ability is nullified. The weather cannot otherwise be changed except by the effects of Delta Stream and Primordial Sea. Air Lock and Cloud Nine will prevent the effects of extremely harsh sunlight, including allowing Water moves to work, but will not allow the weather to be changed.
flavor: O Pokémon muda o clima para anular ataques do tipo Água.

name: delta-stream
effect: Cria uma corrente de ar misteriosa, que não pode ser substituída e faz os golpes nunca serem supereficazes contra Pokémon Voadores.

effect_full: When this Pokémon enters battle and at the end of each turn, if its HP is 50% or above, it changes into Meteor Form; otherwise, it changes into Core Form. flavor: Quando o PS cai para a metade ou menos, a casca do Pokémon quebra e ele fica agressivo.

name: stakeout
effect: Os golpes deste Pokémon têm o dobro de poder contra Pokémon que entraram na batalha neste turno.
effect_full: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.
flavor: Dobra o dano causado a um alvo que acabou de entrar na batalha.

name: water-bubble
effect: Reduz pela metade o dano de golpes de Fogo, dobra o dano de golpes de Água e impede queimaduras.
effect_full: When this Pokémon is hit by a Fire move, the damage is halved. When this Pokémon uses a Water move, the power is doubled. This Pokémon cannot be burned, and if it becomes burned, the burn is immediately cured.
flavor: Diminui o poder dos golpes do tipo Fogo que atingem o Pokémon e impede que ele seja queimado.
